title: About Us
seoDescription: Meet Michael and Katja — locals of Golden Bay offering hand-picked holiday homes with hotel comfort and heartfelt hospitality.
heroCaption: At Ligar Bay Beach – This peaceful spot is one of our personal favourites.
intro: We're Michael and Katja — proud locals of Golden Bay and parents to three beautiful daughters. After moving here a few years ago and falling in love with the natural beauty and lifestyle, we saw the opportunity to combine our backgrounds in hospitality with our passion for quality service. That's how Golden Bay Holiday Homes began — from a desire to offer something local, genuine, and reliable for both guests and homeowners.

sections.heading: What Drives Us
sections.body:
We believe holidays should feel easy, personal, and full of special little moments — and that every guest deserves a warm, well-prepared place to land. At the same time, we understand what it means to entrust someone with your home. As property managers, we take that responsibility seriously and offer a service built on care, communication, and attention to detail.

Whether you're visiting Golden Bay for a short escape or looking for someone to manage your holiday home with the same care you would, we're here to help.

sections.heading: What We Offer
sections.body:
For guests: a hand-picked collection of clean, comfortable homes; hotel-quality linen and thoughtful touches; responsive, friendly local support; and tips to explore the region like a local.

For homeowners: reliable, hands-on property care; transparent communication and personalised service; management of bookings, cleaning, linen, guest care, and more; and peace of mind knowing your home is in good hands.

sections.heading: Our Approach
sections.body:
We run this business the way we like to be treated — with honesty, professionalism, and heart. We take a personal, hands-on approach while ensuring everything runs smoothly and professionally behind the scenes.

Whether you're planning a visit to Golden Bay or looking for a dedicated team to manage your holiday home, we'd love to welcome you into the Golden Bay Holiday Homes family.
